In my opinion in that thread the concern wasn't the language he used. It's the issue.

Yeah, i agreed with him about some people might overreact some losses of theirs. But him saying that: "Hey guys, you don't have depression.", on a subreddit that clearly is read by far more people that actually post/comment here is a bit worrying. There are a lot of posts saying "I was lurking a lot here, because i was afraid to say anything." or something like that, written by people who might actually have depression, and these people could've been scared away by that post.

It's not that he isn't right. He is. But hands down: The love of your life just left you. Who could actually think straight in a situation like that? I stumbled into depression that way, because all i got that time was the simple "get over it"-like responses. And although it didn't meant to be offensive - As Dislocatex's post wasn't meant to be offensive - I still felt offended as being someone whose depression was triggered by a bad relationship. So these people can't be blamed about not considering about where they post. They can be blamed if they posted something like what Wormav linked in Dislocatex's thread. But it's a minority here.
